title: Wandering Geofence Exit Frequency
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:geofence zone_name=* exit_alert=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(exit_alert="yes",1,0))) as matched by zone_name
| eval a_geofence_exit_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_geofence_exit_pct
description: Measures the percentage of location intervals that end with a geofence exit by zone.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which zone are helping or hurting location intervals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a geofence exit` on `care:geofence` events and summarize the hit rate by `zone_name`.
visualization: Table of zone with percentage of location intervals ending with a geofence exit.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often a geofence exit happens for each zone so you can see where location intervals go smoothly or get stuck.
